column4: dialect-gated: this job (go test ./engine/... with only CLEAT_TEST_DB set) runs Postgres and skips MySQL and MSSQL -- cleat#1986 slice 2a's TestWorkflowDefExposureRoundTrips iterates registeredBackends, so its mysql and mssql subtests both skip here while postgres runs. Same registeredBackends shape as, and the same feature as, a-workflow-def-defaults-to-the-auth-exposure-class.tsv beside it: that one pins the column's default, this one pins the class being carried through the stores and back on every read path. Measured by NAME on the cluster job's shape (only CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES set): go test ./engine/ -run '^TestWorkflowDefExposureRoundTrips$' -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly two skips, .../mysql and .../mssql. This test writes no t.Skip of its own -- the skips come from backend.Setup's gate -- so scripts/check-skips.sh is correctly silent about it and this ledger line is the whole record.

Pairing line for the cluster entry above, required by scripts/check-skip-ledger-engine-coverage.py (cleat#2158): engine-race.yml is the only job that checks this key, and it sets one dialect at a time, so the other two arms skip there. Same shape and the same count as the pairing line in a-workflow-def-defaults-to-the-auth-exposure-class.tsv.
